contract.purpose: Full-coverage three-state OHLCV direction research; fixed user-selected horizon bands for all 8 assets
contract.threshold_policy: Fixed per horizon, identical for every asset and origin; not the previous per-asset rolling train_q50 rule
contract.label_rule: down if return_pct < -band_pct; neutral if abs(return_pct) <= band_pct; up if return_pct > band_pct
contract.scaler: Unweighted train-only mean/std, identical across the four candidates; refit on every origin; retain all neutral labels
contract.balanced_weight_rule: pooled training N/(3*class_count), normalized to mean 1; weights for all three states; no test-derived weights
contract.sparse_class_policy: Disclosed per-asset Laplace-smoothed train-prior fallback, no estimator fit
contract.boundary_policy: Reuse parent time sample and remove labels ending exactly at either cutoff; explicit strict boundary parity with ternary v2
contract.calibration_role: Temporal gap parity only; no calibration/test tuning of bands, class weights or thresholds
contract.legacy_policy: Score saved legacy class outputs on the NEW fixed-band labels, with identical test times. Different training targets: diagnostic controls, not retrained candidates.

bootstrap.family: 4 candidates x 5 primary controls x 8 assets x 4 horizons x 2 metrics (accuracy/macro-F1) = 1280 paired comparisons

contract.threshold_provenance: User-selected rounded BTC train_q50 medians after reviewing research reports; retrospectively disclosed, not claimed to be independent preregistration
